script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.

terra.problem: Gideon declines for himself and his son; the text does not say he declines for his whole family.
It gives Midian's defeat as the reason the Israelites offered Gideon the job for good. The text does not give that reason.
“Nobody drags their feet” adds a detail about how promptly everyone acted that the text does not give.
The text does not say everyone Gideon knows can walk by the ephod. The next verse also does not mention its location.
The explanation is flat and repeats the location without much of Papa Dorin's voice.
The text says the ephod was in Ophrah, not at Gideon's front door.
The text does not say the ephod was on a shelf or describe how it looked there.
“Midian had nothing to do with it” makes a broader claim than the verse supports.
The explanation is generic and repeats the same point without much of Papa Dorin's voice.
The text says Gideon was buried in his father's tomb, not that he was laid beside his father.
It identifies the Israelites who turned to the Baals as the same individuals who offered Gideon rule. The text does not establish that.
“His sons don't get asked to lead” claims more than the passage says. It does not record such a request.
